Author: @HalJordan0
Content: As someone whose parents were Irish, I can confirm this is exactly what food in Ireland is like. Anyone who goes to Ireland from the US will love the little differences between life there and life in the US. For example in Ireland you can walk into a movie theatre and get a pint of Guinness just like this, glass and everything, not a little plastic cup like they serve in the US. You can even buy a pint of Guinness in McDonalds in Ireland, just like this one. They also put mayo on fries instead of ketchup, literally drowning them in mayo, sometimes mixed with hot sauce. It may sound weird but don't knock it til u try it.
